context: Tests whether the agent picks the stdio (process-based) MCP transport when the user explicitly wants the server launched as a local subprocess — rather than reaching for HTTP transports that don't apply here.

checklist.name: Uses the process-based MCP transport
checklist.description: Builds the MCP registry using McpToolRegistryProvider.fromProcess(process). Does NOT use streamableHttp or fromSseUrl — the user explicitly chose stdio against a local subprocess

checklist.name: Launches the process with ProcessBuilder
checklist.description: Creates the subprocess via ProcessBuilder("npx", "-y", "@playwright/mcp@latest").start() (or an equivalent constructor producing a java.lang.Process). Each argument is its own element in the command list — does not pass the whole command as a single shell-quoted string

checklist.name: Adds the agents-mcp dependency
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:agents-mcp:1.3.0-beta to build.gradle.kts. Uses the bare coordinate for Gradle; Gradle Module Metadata selects the JVM variant. Does not pin this beta artifact to 1.3.0 stable. The umbrella does not include MCP.

checklist.name: Builds the registry before constructing the agent
checklist.description: Calls McpToolRegistryProvider.fromProcess(...) and assigns it to a variable BEFORE the AIAgent(...) call, then passes that variable as toolRegistry. Does not try to add MCP tools after the agent is constructed

checklist.name: Calls the suspending builder inside a coroutine context
checklist.description: The fromProcess builder runs inside the existing runBlocking { ... } (or another coroutine scope), since it is a suspending call

checklist.name: Does not import Ktor or HTTP-client types
checklist.description: The stdio transport has no HTTP component — the produced file should not import Ktor HttpClient, OkHttp, or any HTTP-transport configuration the agent does not need
